head_commit.message:
Home: the title and the pearl panel start on one line

From 48rem the h1 heads the text column again and the pearl panel spans
both rows beside it; the h1's first line is trimmed to its cap height, so
its capitals and the panel's top edge start on one line. From 80rem the
text column is 32rem wide, so the statement still sets in two lines.

writes draft: false for every entry (PUBLISH_ALL), except the one project

photos, emails and 'now at' remain hidden. site.yml launched stays false
until CMS sign-in is configured.

head_commit.message:
fix(deps): restore missing @tailwindcss/oxide platform entries in package-lock

npm ci failed on the Linux deploy runner (and on any clean install):
the lockfile created on Windows lacked the optional per-platform
@tailwindcss/oxide packages, so package.json and the lock were out of sync.
Regenerated with npm install --package-lock-only: 17 entries added, no
version changes. Verified with a clean npm ci.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
